description: Resumable OpenAI Codex CLI connector that reuses existing CLI authentication, preserves native session IDs, and returns structured JSONL events.

sections.title: Codex
sections.text: Resumable OpenAI Codex CLI connector using provider-owned authentication and native conversation sessions.
list: Config fields: authentication, optional API key, model, sandbox, workspace, session, timeout, approval review, and web search
Output: Structured response, native session ID, Codex JSONL events, usage, status, and errors.

sections.title: Typical workflow
sections.intro: Configure Codex with the connection fields and run it as part of a BrainBoost pipeline.

cards.title: Connect
cards.text: Reuse an existing Codex CLI login by default. Configure workspace and sandbox, then optionally select a model or existing thread ID.

cards.title: Fetch
cards.text: Start datasource and send chat messages. First turn creates a native Codex thread; later turns resume it.

cards.title: Consume
cards.text: Consume normalized response, session ID, native events, usage, and error status from chat UI or downstream automation.

items.q: What do I need to configure?
items.a: Codex CLI must be installed and logged in. Existing-session authentication requires no API key. Workspace defaults to datasource process directory and sandbox defaults to read-only.
Returns structured status, response text, native Codex session ID, JSONL events, usage, and errors.
Outputs are emitted to downstream subscribers in the BrainBoost pipeline. Some datasources also write artifacts (context files, catalogs, or exports) locally based on your configuration.

sections.title: Ready to use Codex?
sections.text: Add it to your BrainBoost pipeline and start ingesting.
sections.subtext: Run this datasource locally with your own credentials and storage.
